about_the_game:
This is a game with four mathematical operations as the core, and you can freely choose your own operation order! Achieve the highest score and winning streak in the shortest time. Compare with your game friends and strangers who are smarter!

Introduction to Play

1. Randomly draw 4 cards in each round. If there is a combination that cannot get 24 points, you can choose to draw cards for the next round.

2. Point introduction: A: 1 point, J: 11 point, Q: 12 point, K: 13 point.

3. Each card can only be used once. Click on the card and the operator to merge the points, and finally merge them into 24 points to complete a game and get the corresponding score. 4. The whole game is limited to 8 minutes.

5. The score is divided into direct bottom score and double bottom score. The initial bottom score is 10 points. Use "+"method to calculate +5 bottom score, use "-"method to calculate +8 bottom score, use "×" method to calculate +1 bottom score, and use "present" method to calculate +3 bottom score.

6. You can get extra points if you complete the winning streak: 3 winning streaks: 30 points, 6 winning streaks: 50 points, 10 winning streaks: 100 points and 11 winning streaks: 200 points.

7. The settlement screen will show your highest number of wins, time spent and final score.

Random Combination

You can freely choose the operation order.

Ranking List

Competing with the scores of friends or strangers, ranking comprehensively with the number of consecutive victories, scores and remaining time as weights.
